slot.brief: Four word pairs (e.g., state:capital type); three share a hidden relationship and one does not — identify the odd pair with justification.

stem: Three of the following pairs have the same relationship. Select the odd pair.

verdicts.working: Paris, Tokyo, and Lima are their countries’ capitals. Australia’s capital is Canberra, not Sydney.

working:
Paris, Tokyo and Lima are the capitals of France, Japan and Peru, respectively. Australia’s capital is Canberra, not Sydney; therefore D is the odd pair. A–C all match the country–capital relationship.

Independent check: Paris, Tokyo, and Lima are their countries’ capitals. Australia’s capital is Canberra, not Sydney.
solution: Paris, Lima, and Tokyo are the capitals of France, Peru, and Japan, respectively. Australia’s capital is Canberra, not Sydney; hence (B) is the odd pair.
